name: Mercado Pago
description: Mercado Pago seller account (Argentina, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay), read-only: payments with fees, net amounts and release dates, merchant orders, subscriptions, payment methods, and the released money and account money reports for reconciliation (generate, list, download). Moves no money.
instructions:
## Mercado Pago
This connector reads a **Mercado Pago** seller account through the official REST API (`https://api.mercadopago.com`): payments and their fees and release dates, merchant orders, subscriptions, payment methods and the two account reports, released money (*Dinero liberado / Dinheiro liberado*) and account money (*Dinero en cuenta*, formerly "all transactions"). Nothing in it moves money: there are no refunds, payouts or charges.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://www.mercadopago.com/developers/panel/app (the Mercado Pago account whose data you want), open **Your integrations** and create an application if you have none (any name; product "Checkout Pro" or "Payments" is fine).
2. In the application open **Production credentials** and activate them (accept the terms). Copy the **Access Token** (`APP_USR-...`) into `MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN`. The Public Key, Client ID and Client Secret are not needed.
3. Install and run `mercado_pago_get_account` to check the token. It shows the country site: MLA Argentina, MLB Brazil, MLM Mexico, MLC Chile, MCO Colombia, MPE Peru, MLU Uruguay.

The access token reaches the whole account: keep it secret and reset it in the same panel if it leaks. Test credentials only see test data, and reports of test accounts are empty.

**Payments**
- `mercado_pago_search_payments` covers the last 12 months: filter by `status`, a date range (`range` picks which date, `begin_date` / `end_date` take `NOW-30DAYS` style or ISO 8601 with milliseconds and offset, e.g. `2026-10-01T00:00:00.000-03:00`) and `external_reference`; 1 to 100 per page, `paging.total` counts the matches. Each row carries the gross `transaction_amount`, `net_received_amount` after fees, `fee_details`, `money_release_date` and the payer.
- `mercado_pago_get_payment` returns the full payment, including refunds and `additional_info` (items, shipping).
- `mercado_pago_search_merchant_orders` (last 90 days) and `mercado_pago_get_merchant_order` group the payments of one Checkout Pro or QR sale.
- `mercado_pago_search_subscriptions` lists subscriptions (preapprovals); `mercado_pago_list_payment_methods` the methods of the account's country.

**Reports**: for bookkeeping and reconciliation use the reports rather than paging through payments.
1. `mercado_pago_list_release_reports` / `mercado_pago_list_settlement_reports` show what already exists, including the scheduled reports set up in the Mercado Pago panel.
2. `mercado_pago_create_release_report` / `mercado_pago_create_settlement_report` generate one for a period (`begin_date`, `end_date` in UTC, e.g. `2026-10-01T03:00:00Z` for midnight in Buenos Aires). Generation is asynchronous and takes a minute or more; Mercado Pago refuses an end date beyond its cut-off and says which date is allowed.
3. List again until the report's `status` is `processed`, then `mercado_pago_download_release_report` / `mercado_pago_download_settlement_report` with its `file_name`. CSV files come back as semicolon-separated text with a header row (columns as configured in the panel, e.g. DATE, SOURCE_ID, DESCRIPTION, NET_CREDIT_AMOUNT, NET_DEBIT_AMOUNT, GROSS_AMOUNT, MP_FEE_AMOUNT); XLSX files come back as a file. Text over 200 KB is cut: use shorter periods.

**Amounts and dates**: amounts are in the account currency (`currency_id`: ARS, BRL, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN, UYU), as decimals. Payment dates carry the account's time zone offset; report dates are UTC.

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong, reset or test token. 403 means the token's application lacks access to that resource. 404 on a payment means it belongs to another account. 429 (`local_rate_limited`, `too_many_requests`) means too many calls in a short time: wait a minute.
prerequisites: A Mercado Pago account and the production Access Token of an application under Your integrations (developers panel).

MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Mercado Pago developers panel, Your integrations, your application, Production credentials: the Access Token starting with APP_USR-.
MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the Access Token alone (APP_USR-...), without Bearer, spaces or quotes. The Public Key is not the token.

verifyHints.401: Mercado Pago refused the access token. Copy the production Access Token (APP_USR-...) again from Your integrations, Production credentials; a reset token replaces the old one.
verifyHints.403: The token works, but its application may not read this. Check the application in the developers panel.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Mercado Pago is throttling the calls. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: mercado_pago_get_account
tools.description: Get the Mercado Pago account behind the access token: user id, nickname, name, e-mail, country, site (MLA Argentina, MLB Brazil, MLM Mexico, MLC Chile, MCO Colombia, MPE Peru, MLU Uruguay) and account type. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: mercado_pago_search_payments
tools.description: Search the payments received by the account (the last 12 months at most): id, status, amount, net received after fees, fees, payment method, installments, payer, external reference and money release date. Filter by status and a date range on date_created, date_approved, date_last_updated or money_release_date. paging.total is the number of matches; page with offset.

range.description: Which date begin_date and end_date apply to. Default date_created.

begin_date.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601 with milliseconds and offset, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000-03:00, or relative: NOW, NOW-7DAYS, NOW-1MONTH.

end_date.description: End of the range. ISO 8601 with milliseconds and offset, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000-03:00, or relative: NOW, NOW-7DAYS, NOW-1MONTH.

external_reference.description: Your own reference (order number) sent when the payment was created.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

tools.name: mercado_pago_get_payment
tools.description: Get every detail of one payment by id: status and status_detail, amounts, fees and net received, refunds, payment method and card brand, installments, payer, items and shipping in additional_info, release date and the related order.

tools.name: mercado_pago_search_merchant_orders
tools.description: Search merchant orders (the order behind a Checkout Pro or QR sale, grouping its payments and shipments) of the last 90 days: status opened, closed or expired, paid and total amounts, payments, items. Page with offset.

external_reference.description: Your own reference sent with the preference.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

tools.name: mercado_pago_get_merchant_order
tools.description: Get one merchant order by id: status, order_status, total and paid amounts, items, its payments and shipments.

tools.name: mercado_pago_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods available to the account in its country: id (visa, master, pix, bolbradesco, account_money...), name, type (credit_card, debit_card, ticket, bank_transfer...), status, minimum and maximum amount and accreditation time in minutes.

transform.expression: [].{id: id, name: name, payment_type_id: payment_type_id, status: status, min_allowed_amount: min_allowed_amount, max_allowed_amount: max_allowed_amount, accreditation_time: accreditation_time}

tools.name: mercado_pago_list_release_reports
tools.description: List the released money reports (Dinero liberado / Dinheiro liberado: the money that became available, with each payment, fee, refund and withdrawal) already generated for the account, newest last: id, begin_date, end_date, status (pending, processing, processed, failed), file_name and format. Download a processed one with mercado_pago_download_release_report.

tools.name: mercado_pago_create_release_report
tools.description: Ask Mercado Pago to generate a released money report (Dinero liberado / Dinheiro liberado: the money that became available, with each payment, fee, refund and withdrawal) for a period. Generation is asynchronous: list the reports after a minute or two and download the file once its status is processed. Dates are UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z; Mercado Pago refuses an end date in the future or beyond its own cut-off and names the latest allowed date in the error. Creates a file on the account; moves no money.

begin_date.description: Start of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end_date.description: End of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-15T23:59:59Z.

tools.name: mercado_pago_download_release_report
tools.description: Download one released money report by its file_name (from mercado_pago_list_release_reports). CSV reports come back as text (semicolon-separated, a header row first); XLSX reports come back as a file. Very large reports are cut at 200 KB: generate a shorter period instead.

file_name.description: file_name from the report list, e.g. release-report-123456789-2026-10-21-111911.csv.

tools.name: mercado_pago_list_settlement_reports
tools.description: List the account money reports (Dinero en cuenta, formerly "all transactions": every movement of the account balance) already generated for the account, newest last: id, begin_date, end_date, status (pending, processing, processed, failed), file_name and format. Download a processed one with mercado_pago_download_settlement_report.

tools.name: mercado_pago_create_settlement_report
tools.description: Ask Mercado Pago to generate a account money report (Dinero en cuenta, formerly "all transactions": every movement of the account balance) for a period. Generation is asynchronous: list the reports after a minute or two and download the file once its status is processed. Dates are UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z; Mercado Pago refuses an end date in the future or beyond its own cut-off and names the latest allowed date in the error. Creates a file on the account; moves no money.

begin_date.description: Start of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end_date.description: End of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-15T23:59:59Z.

tools.name: mercado_pago_download_settlement_report
tools.description: Download one account money report by its file_name (from mercado_pago_list_settlement_reports). CSV reports come back as text (semicolon-separated, a header row first); XLSX reports come back as a file. Very large reports are cut at 200 KB: generate a shorter period instead.

file_name.description: file_name from the report list, e.g. release-report-123456789-2026-10-21-111911.csv.

tools.name: mercado_pago_search_subscriptions
tools.description: Search subscriptions (preapprovals) of the account: id, status (pending, authorized, paused, cancelled), payer e-mail, plan, reason, amount and frequency, next payment date. Page with offset.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.
